proposal.explanation: Track the prior value of signal_in so the existing pulse expression detects a rising signal while enable is asserted.

+++ b/rtl/pulse.v

     if (rst) begin previous <= 1'b0; pulse_out <= 1'b0; end
     else begin
-        previous <= enable;
+        previous <= signal_in;
         pulse_out <= enable && signal_in && !previous;
     end
